final_claim.narrative: Group activity volume is roughly flat across the period (145-207 events per 5k bin, step_01), and the graph as a whole is sparse/low-repeat (step_02), so neither a volume surge nor globally popular hubs explains the pattern. However, the identity of partners changes abruptly at t~43052. For representative members 327 and 1220, the contact sets in [33052,38051] and [38052,43051] overlap heavily with each other (shared partners 916, 1186, 1294, 1308, 1590, 1798, 913, 992, 1347, 788, 1165, 1556, 1575), i.e. a stable 'old' community shared by the group. In the immediately following half-window [43052,48051] both nodes' partner sets are essentially disjoint from the old one and instead consist of a common 'new' set (224, 823, 1132, 1372, 1698, 1728, ...). Jaccard overlap across the change point is ~0 while within-regime overlap is high, and the switch is shared across group members, which is the signature of a regime switch rather than gradual turnover.
